title: Reading Drill — The Weight of a Travelling Exhibition
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: The Weight of a Travelling Exhibition
passages.body:
**A** A travelling exhibition had to fit into a small delivery van. Its organisers specified a maximum case weight so one person could move a display panel without assistance.

**B** Prototypes used thinner boards, but light shone through them. Designers added a dark lining rather than making the boards heavier again.

**C** The finished panels could be packed in any order because their latches were identical. The van driver still used a numbered loading plan to avoid wasting space.
